quarterly_data.signal: Outlook (IR deck 10-16-2026): in wafer-level packaging the company expects advanced-packaging technology to expand with the AI market (data centers, autonomous driving) and packaging outsourcing volume to keep growing as domestic foundry capacity is added; in electronic materials it expects Korean chipmakers to accelerate localisation of copper plating solution, materials demand to rise as HBM4 mass-production volume grows, and projects copper plating solution growth at a CAGR of +25%; in lead tabs it is diversifying customers, including an overseas customer entering mass production, and expects revenue from new fire-retardant safety products for EVs to ramp in earnest in 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: copper plating solution growth CAGR +25% (deck projection)

quarterly_data.signal: Supply view (IR deck 10-16-2026, wafer-level packaging outlook): the company says a shortage of legacy (8-inch) production facilities means the supply shortage is continuing.

Panel-level packaging and materials strategy (IR deck 10-16-2026): for a 50mm x 50mm package the company shows 100 units per 600x600mm PLP panel vs 16 units per 300mm wafer (6.25x the area), claims world-first mass production on the 600x600mm panel, calls PLP the ultimate solution for AI (heterogeneous integration of multiple chiplets in one package) and says a sharp increase in reticle size is accelerating adoption of large-panel FOPLP; it names three barriers to entry - technology (warpage, die drift, large-area process uniformity), capex for PLP mass-production lines, and limited ecosystem readiness in equipment and materials. In electronic materials it plans to improve margins by in-sourcing copper plating solution raw materials, alongside a higher share of high-margin products and manufacturing efficiency.
